Wondrous.name: War Horn of Valor
Wondrous.description: +1. This brass war horn is engraved with the war rune, which glows purple when the horn is blown. You can blow the horn as a bonus action. When you do, if you have the frightened condition, you immediately end that condition on yourself. You also have advantage on saving throws against being frightened until the start of your next turn. When you blow the horn, you can also invoke the rune, imbuing the horn's deep call with protective magic that affects creatures of your choice within 30 feet of yourself. You and all affected creatures gain a +1 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. Once the rune has been invoked, it can't be invoked again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Warrior's Passkey
Wondrous.description: +1. This silver skeleton key is warm to the touch. While holding the key in its key form, you can use an action to cast the Knock spell from the key. While holding the key, you can use a bonus action to transform it into a magic longsword. You are considered proficient with the sword, and you have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. On a hit, the sword deals 1d10 force damage. The item remains in its sword form until it leaves your grasp or you use another bonus action to revert it to its key form. If you end your attunement to the item while it's in its sword form, it automatically reverts to its key form.

Wondrous.name: Watchful Greathelm
Wondrous.description: +1. While you wear this helm, you gain a +1 bonus to AC and remain aware of your surroundings even while you're asleep, and you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. As a bonus action, you can cast the see invisibility spell from the helm. Once this property of the helm is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Wayfarer's Boots
Wondrous.description: This pair of boots is made of durable cloth, with the journey rune stitched in golden thread above each heel. While you are wearing this item, your walking speed increases by 10 feet, and you have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks. As a bonus action, you can invoke the boots' runes to cast the expeditious retreat spell with them. Once the runes have been invoked, they can't be invoked again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Weird Tank
Wondrous.description: A weird tank is a ten-gallon tank of blown glass and sculpted bronze with a backpack-like carrying harness fashioned from tough leather. A water weird is contained within the tank. While wearing the tank, you can use an action to open it, allowing the water weird to emerge. You can command the water weird telepathically (no action required) while you wear the tank. You can close the tank as an action only if you have first commanded the water weird to retract into it or if the water weird is dead. The tank has AC 15, 50 hit points, vulnerability to bludgeoning damage, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.

Wondrous.name: Well of Many Worlds
Wondrous.description: This fine black cloth, soft as silk, is folded up to the dimensions of a handkerchief. It unfolds into a circular sheet 6 feet in diameter. You can take a Magic action to unfold the Well of Many Worlds and place it on a solid surface, whereupon it forms a two-way, 6-foot-diameter, circular portal to another world or plane of existence. Each time the item opens a portal, the DM decides where it leads. The portal remains open until a creature within 5 feet of it takes a Magic action to close it by taking hold of the edges of the cloth and folding it up. Once the Well of Many Worlds has opened a portal, it can't do so again for 1d8 hours.

Wondrous.name: Wheel of Stars
Wondrous.description: While attuned to this device, you have a +1 bonus to Wisdom saving throws, and you can use an action to cast the dancing lights, guidance, or message cantrips. As a reaction when a creature you can see within 60 feet of you makes an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check, you make that creature roll a d10 and add or subtract the number rolled (your choice) from the roll. Once you use this feature of the wheel of stars, it cannot be used again until the next dawn. As an action, you can cast fly on yourself or you can cast levitate (save DC 15).

Wondrous.name: Wheel of Wind and Water
Wondrous.description: When mounted at the helm of an elemental galleon or airship, this wheel allows a creature that possesses the Mark of Storm to telepathically control the elemental bound inside the vessel. If a wheel of wind and water is mounted on a mundane sailing ship, a creature with the Mark of Storm who is using the wheel can create an area of ideal conditions around the vessel, increasing its speed by 5 miles per hour.

Wondrous.name: Shadowlands Whisper Jar
Wondrous.description: The jar is used to record others' stories and your own observations, like a verbal notebook with unlimited space. The whisper jar records as fast as a creature can speak into it, and whispers back words at the same pace they were recorded. Activating the playback of a particular recording is an action. As a bonus action, you ask the jar for information on a specific subject and make a DC 15 Intelligence (History) check. This property of the whisper jar can't be used again until the next dawn. As an action, you can cause the jar to function as a wand of enemy detection, whereupon it whispers the direction to foes within range.

Wondrous.name: White Chromatic Rose
Wondrous.description: Chromatic Rose

Wondrous.name: White Dragon Mask
Wondrous.description: This dragonflight mask grants draconic presence, improved defenses, and resistance tied to its color. It also enhances breath or elemental powers at the DM's discretion.

Wondrous.name: Wind Fan
Wondrous.description: While holding this fan, you can cast Gust of Wind (save DC 13) from it. Each subsequent time the fan is used before the next dawn, it has a cumulative 20 chance of not working; if the fan fails to work, it tears into useless, nonmagical tatters.

Wondrous.name: Windskiff
Wondrous.description: This small piece of jewelry has 3 charges and regains all expended charges daily at dawn. While you are holding it, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge, which causes the jewelry to transform into a sail-powered personal vehicle. After 1 hour or until you use the item's command word (no action required), the transformation ends and the Windskiff reverts to its jewelry form. In vehicle form, a Windskiff is a Medium object with the following statistics: AC 12, HP 30, and Speed 40 ft. A Windskiff and its riders take no damage from falling.

Wondrous.name: Winged Boots
Wondrous.description: These boots have 4 charges and regain 1d4 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the boots, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge, gaining a Fly Speed of 30 feet for 1 hour. If you are flying when the duration expires, you descend at a rate of 30 feet per round until you land.

Wondrous.name: Wings of Flying
Wondrous.description: While wearing this cloak, you can take a Magic action to turn the cloak into a pair of wings on your back. The wings lasts for 1 hour or until you end the effect early as a Magic action. The wings give you a Fly Speed of 60 feet. If you are aloft when the wings disappear, you fall. When the wings disappear, you can't use them again for 1d12 hours.

Wondrous.name: Wingwear
Wondrous.description: This snug uniform has symbols of air stitched into it and leathery flaps that stretch along the arms, waist, and legs to create wings for gliding. A suit of wingwear has 3 charges. While you wear the suit, you can use a bonus action and expend 1 charge to gain a flying speed of 30 feet until you land. When your altitude drops to 0 feet, you land (or fall), and you must expend another charge to use the suit again. The suit regains all of its expended charges after spending at least 1 hour in an elemental air node.

Wondrous.name: Darkmoon Witchlight Vane
Wondrous.description: +3. This ornate rod is topped by a pair of butterfly wings and incorporates bits of red glass into its length. In the hands of one who is attuned to it, the vane can be wielded as a magic mace that grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. In addition, the vane deals an extra 1d8 radiant damage on a hit. While the vane is inside the perimeter of the Darkmoon Faire, it can sense the mood of every creature in the carnival that has an Intelligence of 4 or higher. As an action, a creature attuned to the vane can use it to pinpoint the location of the happiest creature in the carnival.

Wondrous.name: Darkmoon Witchlight Watch
Wondrous.description: This ornate pocket watch is fastened to the end of a gold chain. It glows with a faint golden light when opened, and it makes a soft ticking noise that can be heard only by the creature holding it. The face of the watch shows a miniature painting of the Darkmoon Faire ringed by a tiny henge, orbited at night by a mote of light small enough to slip through the eye of a needle. This light causes the henge to cast shadows, and these shadows allow the watch's owner to track the passage of time. The creature attuned to the watch can use an action to initiate the packing up or the unpacking of the Darkmoon Faire, provided the creature and the carnival are on the same plane of existence.

Wondrous.name: Cenarion Primer
Wondrous.description: The Cenarion Primer is a magic textbook created at Dalaran's Cenarion College. The primer has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. If you make an Intelligence (Nature) or Wisdom (Survival) check while holding the primer, you can expend 1 charge to give yourself a 1d4 bonus to the check, immediately after you roll the d20. In addition, if you study the primer at the end of a long rest, you can choose one 1st-level spell from the druid or wizard spell list. Before you finish your next long rest, you can cast the chosen spell once without a spell slot if you are holding the primer.

Wondrous.name: Wreath of the Dragonflights (Dormant)
Wondrous.description: This loop of golden thorns is inset with dozens of gems representing the five colors of the Chromatic Dragonflight. While wearing the wreath in its dormant state, you have darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have darkvision, wearing the wreath increases the range of your darkvision by 60 feet. When you hit a beast, dragon, or monstrosity of challenge rating 5 or lower with an attack, or when you grapple it, you can use the wreath to cast dominate monster on the creature (save DC 13). On a successful save, the target is immune to the power of the wreath for 24 hours.

Wondrous.name: Wyrmreaver Gauntlets
Wondrous.description: Originally crafted for ground-bound giant brawlers to fight against dragons and other enormous predators of the sky, these studded gauntlets are engraved with the dragon rune. While you are wearing these gauntlets, your unarmed strike deals an additional 1d6 force damage on a hit. Additionally, whenever you finish a long rest, choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. You have resistance to the chosen damage type until you finish another long rest. As a bonus action, you can invoke the gauntlets' runes and summon two enormous spectral fists that envelop the gauntlets and mimic your hand motions.

Wondrous.name: Wyrmskull Throne
Wondrous.description: Built by dwarven gods and entrusted to the rulers of Shanatar, an ancient dwarven empire. The Wyrmskull Throne was a symbol of dwarven power and pride for ages untold. The throne hovers a foot off the ground and is a massive thing made of polished obsidian with oversized feet-the impaled skulls of four ancient blue dragons. Runes glisten in the carved obsidian winking to life with blue energy when the throne's powers are activated. After the fall of Shanatar, the Wyrmskull Throne fell into the clutches of less honorable creatures. A band of adventurers wrested the throne from the aquatic elf tyrant Gantar Kraok and sold it to the storm giant Neri for a considerable fortune. Neri had the throne magically enlarged and gave it to her husband, King Hekaton, as a gift, along with one of the Ruling Scepters of Shanatar, which she had found in a wreck at the bottom of the Trackless Sea. Only a creature attuned to a Ruling Scepter and in possession of it can harness the powers of the Wyrmskull Throne, which has become the centerpiece of King Hekaton's throne room in the undersea citadel of Maelstrom. Fear of the throne's power has helped prevent evil giants from challenging or threatening Hekaton's leadership. Any creature not attuned to a Ruling Scepter who sits on the throne is paralyzed and encased in a magical force field. While encased, the creature can't be touched or moved from the throne. Touching a Ruling Scepter to the force field dispels the field, though the creature remains paralyzed until it is separated from the throne. Any creature seated on the throne can hear faint Whispers in Draconic-the whisperings of four blue dragons whose skulls adorn the throne. Although powerless, these spirits try to influence the decisions of the throne's master. The throne has 9 charges and regains all expended charges daily at dawn. A creature that sits on the throne while attuned to a Ruling Sceptor in its possession can harness the throne's properties, which are as follows: The throne gains a flying speed of 30 feet and can hover and flies where the creature wills. This property doesn't expend any charges. Both the throne and the creature sitting on it can move through earth and stone without disturbing the material they move through. This property doesn't expend any charges. As an action, the creature can expend 1 charge to cast lightning bolt (spell save DC 19) from the throne. The spell is cast as though using a 9th-level spell slot and deals 49 (14d6) lightning damage. The bolt discharges from the mouth of one of the throne's blue dragon skulls. As an action, the creature can expend 2 charges to cast the globe of invulnerability spell from the throne. The globe encloses both the creature and the throne. As an action, the creature can expend 3 charges to create a spectral image of an ancient blue dragon that surrounds both it and the throne. The spectral dragon lasts for 1 minute. At the end of each of the creature's turns, the spectral dragon makes one bite attack and two claw attacks against targets of the creature's choice. These attacks have the same attack bonus, reach, and damage as an ancient blue dragon bite and claw attacks. The Wyrmskull Throne can be destroyed by breaking at least five Ruling Scepters of Shanatar simultaneously on it. This fact has never been recorded or sung of among the dwarves or any bards or storytellers, and it can't be discovered with an ability check. Characters who want to destroy the throne must go on a quest to learn the method for doing so. The throne's destruction triggers an explosion, as shards of obsidian fly out in all directions. Each creature and object within a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the throne must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Wondrous.name: Highborne Ley Core
Wondrous.description: A massive arcane crystal engine that can levitate nearby structures, recharge magic items, control weather over a vast area, and disintegrate objects or burn creatures that touch its core.

Wondrous.name: Choker of the Fire Lord
Wondrous.description: Necklace made of burning magma rock

Wondrous.name: Mantle of the Tempest
Wondrous.description: Shoulders crackling with contained lightning

Wondrous.name: Cloak of the Devoured
Wondrous.description: Tattered cape that absorbs magical light

Wondrous.name: Robe of the Archmage
Wondrous.description: Silken robes woven with mana-regenerating threads

Wondrous.name: Vestments of the Shifting Sands
Wondrous.description: Robes that constantly change color and pattern

Wondrous.name: Bindings of the Tunneling Worm
Wondrous.description: Wrists made from hardened subterranean carapace

Wondrous.name: Handguards of the Avatar
Wondrous.description: Gloves that leave a trail of arcane dust

Wondrous.name: Belt of Blasting
Wondrous.description: Heavy cloth sash radiating intense heat

Wondrous.name: Leggings of the Kirin Tor
Wondrous.description: Pants embroidered with the eye of Dalaran

Wondrous.name: Slippers of the Seacaller
Wondrous.description: Boots that leave wet footprints on dry ground

Wondrous.name: Band of the Eternal Sage
Wondrous.description: Ring that hums when near ley lines

Wondrous.name: Ring of Ancient Knowledge
Wondrous.description: Gold band inscribed with dead languages

Wondrous.name: Neltharion's Tear
Wondrous.description: Black liquid gem that grants supreme focus

Wondrous.name: Zandalarian Hero Charm
Wondrous.description: Tribal fetish that boosts spell potency briefly

Wondrous.name: Dislodged Foreign Object
Wondrous.description: Otherworldly organ pulsing with necrotic magic

Wondrous.name: Phylactery of the Nameless Lich
Wondrous.description: Small box containing cold undead essence

Wondrous.name: Spire of Twilight
Wondrous.description: Staff topped with a candle that never melts

Wondrous.name: Staff of the Shadow Flame
Wondrous.description: Twisted stave topped with a dragon skull

Wondrous.name: Blade of the Nexus
Wondrous.description: Crystalline dagger vibrating with blue energy

Wondrous.name: Turning Tide
Wondrous.description: Blade that drips seawater and smells of ozone

Wondrous.name: Tempest of Chaos
Wondrous.description: Sword surrounded by small floating fel rocks

Wondrous.name: Chronicle of Dark Secrets
Wondrous.description: Tome bound in demon skin that whispers to the holder

Wondrous.name: Talisman of Kalecgos
Wondrous.description: Orb containing the essence of the Blue Dragonflight

Wondrous.name: Wand of Fates
Wondrous.description: Slender wand carved from bone and gold

Wondrous.name: Cowl of the Illidari High Lord
Wondrous.description: Hood with glowing fel-green eye lenses

Wondrous.name: Hex Shrunken Head
Wondrous.description: Troll artifact that radiates voodoo magic

Wondrous.name: Amice of the Convoker
Wondrous.description: Shoulderguards floating slightly above the wearer

Wondrous.name: Robes of the Guardian Saint
Wondrous.description: Robes depicting ancient titan watchers

Wondrous.name: Kirin Tor Emergency Sigil
Wondrous.description: This palm-sized violet sigil has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast shield, feather fall, or misty step. The sigil flashes with the eye of Dalaran when its last charge is spent.

Wondrous.name: Goblin Panic Button
Wondrous.description: This red brass button can be pressed as a reaction when you take damage. Roll a d4: on a 1, you are pushed 10 feet in a random direction; on a 2-4, you gain 2d6 temporary hit points and can move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. Once used, the button can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Priest's Prayer Ribbon
Wondrous.description: This white cloth ribbon is wrapped around the wrist or holy symbol. As an action, you can untie it to cast bless without expending a spell slot. The spell lasts for 1 minute and requires concentration. Once used, the ribbon becomes nonmagical.

Wondrous.name: Gnomish Rotor Belt
Wondrous.description: This belt unfolds a pair of sputtering rotors. As a bonus action, you can activate it to gain a flying speed of 30 feet until the end of your current turn. If you end that turn in the air, you descend safely up to 60 feet. The belt has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

Wondrous.name: Skyguard Glider Harness
Wondrous.description: While wearing this folded canvas harness, you can use your reaction when falling to glide instead. Until you land, you fall 60 feet per round and can move up to 30 feet horizontally each round. The harness does not let you gain altitude.

Wondrous.name: Goblin Rocket Anklets
Wondrous.description: These iron anklets are packed with tiny rockets. As a bonus action, you can fly up to 40 feet in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks. At the end of the movement, make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw; on a failure, you fall prone. The anklets have 3 charges and regain 1d3 charges daily at dawn.

Wondrous.name: Goblin Oxygen Mask
Wondrous.description: This dented mask lets you breathe underwater and in smoky or poisonous air for up to 1 hour. Once the air canister is used, it must be replaced during a short or long rest with tinker's tools or alchemist's supplies.

Wondrous.name: Enchanted Nagahunter's Mask
Wondrous.description: While wearing this lacquered mask, you can breathe underwater, gain darkvision out to 60 feet while submerged, and have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to detect Naga or other aquatic creatures.

Wondrous.name: Tidesage Reed Breather
Wondrous.description: This braided reed mouthpiece smells of salt and storm rain. While holding it in your mouth, you can breathe underwater for 1 hour. Once used, it can't be used again until it has soaked in clean water for 8 hours.

Wondrous.name: Blinkstone Ring
Wondrous.description: This ring holds a small blue-white stone. As a bonus action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Once used, the ring can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Mage's Emergency Recall Bead
Wondrous.description: As an action, you can crush this glass bead to mark your current space for 1 hour. While the mark lasts, you can use a bonus action to teleport back to the nearest unoccupied space to the mark, provided you are within 300 feet of it. The bead is destroyed after the teleport.

Wondrous.name: Smuggler's Doorway Chalk
Wondrous.description: This black chalk has 3 uses. As an action, you can draw a small mark on a door, window, hatch, or loose wall panel. For the next 10 minutes, you have advantage on ability checks made to open, pick, force, or quietly bypass that marked entry.

Wondrous.name: Goblin Ejector Boots
Wondrous.description: When a creature you can see ends its turn within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to launch yourself up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. Once used, the boots can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Dalaran Bookmark
Wondrous.description: This silver bookmark can be placed in a book, map, or scroll as an action. Until the next dawn, you can use a bonus action to teleport the marked object to your hand if it is on the same plane and within 1 mile of you. Once used, the bookmark can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Lightforged Barrier Rosary
Wondrous.description: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to gain 2d6 temporary hit points before the damage is applied. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Shamanic Stone-Skin Totem
Wondrous.description: As a bonus action, you can plant this palm-sized totem in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. For 1 minute, you and allies within 10 feet of the totem reduce bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage by 2. Once used, the totem can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Necromancer's Bone Ward
Wondrous.description: This carved rib bone hangs from a cord. When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to gain 2d8 temporary hit points. If the creature was undead, you gain 3d8 temporary hit points instead. Once used, the ward can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Arcane Shell Brooch
Wondrous.description: When you fail a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, you can use your reaction to add 1d6 to the roll, potentially turning the failure into a success. Once used, the brooch can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Gnomish Impact Diffuser
Wondrous.description: This belt-mounted device has 3 charges and regains 1d3 charges daily at dawn. When you take falling damage or bludgeoning damage, you can use your reaction and expend 1 charge to reduce that damage by 1d10.

Wondrous.name: Dwarven Bracers of Bracing
Wondrous.description: When you are pushed, pulled, knocked prone, or moved against your will, you can use your reaction to reduce that forced movement by up to 20 feet and remain standing. You also have advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone while standing on stone or worked earth.

Wondrous.name: Waterspeaker's Shell Gorget
Wondrous.description: When you take fire, cold, or lightning damage while in rain, mist, shallow water, or fully submerged, you can use your reaction to reduce that damage by 2d10. Once used, the gorget can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Fel-Scorched Plate Shard
Wondrous.description: This armor fragment can be strapped over the heart. When you take fire damage, you can use your reaction to reduce that damage by 1d10. If the damage is from a demon or fel source, reduce it by 2d10 instead. Once used, the shard can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Shield Rune Patch
Wondrous.description: This embroidered rune can be pressed onto armor or a shield as an action. The next time the wearer takes damage, the rune flares and reduces the damage by 2d6, then burns away.

Wondrous.name: Thornsap Bracers
Wondrous.description: These greenwood bracers bead with sticky sap. When a creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal 1d8 piercing damage to it. If you are in a forest, grove, or overgrown ruin, the damage increases to 2d8.

Wondrous.name: Stormcaller's Copper Ring
Wondrous.description: When a creature within 30 feet deals lightning damage to you or an ally you can see, you can use your reaction to force that creature to make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 2d8 lightning damage; on a success, it takes half as much.

Wondrous.name: Void Mirror Pendant
Wondrous.description: When you take psychic or necrotic damage, you can use your reaction to reduce that damage by 2d8 and deal psychic damage equal to the amount reduced to one creature you can see within 30 feet. Once used, the pendant can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Gnomish Combat Monocle
Wondrous.description: This brass monocle highlights weak points in red. When you score a critical hit against a creature you can see, you can force the target to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is stunned until the start of your next turn. Once used, the monocle can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Hunter's Quickdraw Glove
Wondrous.description: Once on each of your turns when you make a ranged weapon attack, you can draw a piece of ammunition or thrown weapon as part of the attack and ignore the loading property for that attack.

Wondrous.name: Animated Offhand Trinket
Wondrous.description: This fist-sized clockwork token can be attached to a light melee weapon. As a bonus action, you can command the weapon to make one melee attack against a creature within 5 feet of you, using your attack bonus. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Stormcharged Weapon Grip
Wondrous.description: This copper-and-leather grip can be wrapped around a melee weapon during a short rest. Once per turn when you hit with that weapon, you can deal an extra 1d4 lightning damage. During a storm, the extra damage becomes 1d6.

Wondrous.name: Hex Needle
Wondrous.description: As an action, you can prick a creature within 5 feet with this black needle. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you until the end of its next turn. Once used, the needle breaks.

Wondrous.name: Frost-Snare Anklet
Wondrous.description: As a bonus action, you can cause frost to snap around a creature you can see within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or its speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn. Once used, the anklet can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Nagahunter Net Spool
Wondrous.description: This belt spool launches a weighted net. As an action, choose one Large or smaller creature within 30 feet. It must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained until the end of its next turn. Underwater, the target has disadvantage on the save.

Wondrous.name: Voidglass Fear Idol
Wondrous.description: As an action, you can reveal this black glass idol to one creature that can see you within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its next turn. Aberrations have disadvantage on the save. Once used, the idol can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Argent Purity Seal
Wondrous.description: As an action, you can press this wax-and-silver seal to a creature and end one of the following conditions on it: charmed, frightened, or poisoned. If the condition was caused by an undead, fiend, or curse, the target also gains 2d6 temporary hit points.

Wondrous.name: Pocket Grounding Totem
Wondrous.description: As a reaction when you or a creature within 10 feet fails a saving throw against a spell, you can snap this tiny totem in half to add 1d8 to the roll, potentially turning the failure into a success. The totem is destroyed.

Wondrous.name: Lightforged Tear Crystal
Wondrous.description: As an action, you can touch this crystal to a creature and end the blinded, charmed, frightened, or poisoned condition on it. Once used, the crystal can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Waterspeaker's Pendant
Wondrous.description: While you are in rain, mist, shallow water, or fully submerged, your healing spells and magical healing items restore an additional 1d4 hit points. While fully submerged, you also have advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks.

Wondrous.name: Ashen Forge Cincture
Wondrous.description: While you are within 30 feet of open flame, lava, a forge, or burning terrain, your melee weapon attacks deal an extra 1 fire damage. Once per dawn while in such an area, you can use a bonus action to gain resistance to fire damage for 1 minute.

Wondrous.name: Moonwell Vial
Wondrous.description: This sealed vial glows brighter under moonlight or near sacred pools. While in moonlight, a grove, or within 30 feet of a moonwell, you can use an action to drink from it and regain 3d6 hit points. The vial refills at the next dusk.

Wondrous.name: Dalaran Ley Compass
Wondrous.description: This compass points toward nearby portals, teleportation circles, and strong arcane auras within 1 mile. While in a mage tower, library, or ley-rich area, you can use it to cast detect magic at will.

Wondrous.name: Cryptbone Ring
Wondrous.description: While underground, in a tomb, or within 60 feet of undead, this ring grants you darkvision out to 60 feet. If you already have darkvision, its range increases by 30 feet. Once per dawn in such a place, you can cast false life on yourself.

Wondrous.name: Stormcaller Anklet
Wondrous.description: While you are in rain, strong wind, or aboard a ship, your jump distance increases by 10 feet and you have advantage on checks made to keep your footing.

Wondrous.name: Goblin Hazard Goggles
Wondrous.description: While wearing these goggles, smoke, sparks, and nonmagical dust don't lightly obscure your vision. In mines, workshops, factories, or smoky battlefields, you also have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight.

Wondrous.name: Sandwalker Sash
Wondrous.description: While wearing this sash in deserts, dry ruins, or dusty badlands, you ignore nonmagical difficult terrain made of sand or loose stone and have advantage on Constitution saving throws against extreme heat.

Wondrous.name: Cenarion Rootband
Wondrous.description: While in a forest, grove, or overgrown ruin, you can move through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them. Once per dawn while in such a place, you can cast entangle (save DC 15).

Wondrous.name: Black Market Lucky Coin
Wondrous.description: While you are in a city, tavern, auction house, or back alley market, you can flip this coin before making a Charisma (Deception, Persuasion, or Sleight of Hand) check to add 1d4 to the roll. Once used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Lightforged Sun Clasp
Wondrous.description: While you are in bright light or a holy place, you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened. Once per dawn while in such a place, you can use a bonus action to shed sunlight in a 10-foot radius for 1 minute.

Wondrous.name: Voidglass Lens
Wondrous.description: While you are in darkness, dreams, or an old god-tainted place, you can see invisible creatures and objects within 10 feet of you. Once per dawn while in such a place, you can cast detect thoughts (save DC 15).

Wondrous.name: Dwarven Forge Tally
Wondrous.description: While underground, in a forge, or within 30 feet of worked stone or metal, you have advantage on Intelligence checks made to appraise, identify, repair, or sabotage metalwork and stonework.

Wondrous.name: Naga Pearl Circlet
Wondrous.description: While underwater or within 60 feet of a Naga, you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed and against effects that would move you against your will. You can also speak Aquan while wearing the circlet.

Wondrous.name: Innkeeper's Hearthstone Mug
Wondrous.description: During a short rest, you can drink from this warm mug to gain 1d6 temporary hit points. If the rest takes place in a tavern, inn, camp, or beside a hearth, you instead gain 2d6 temporary hit points. Once used, the mug can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Windwake Cloak
Wondrous.description: This cloak always moves as if caught by a gentle breeze. As a bonus action, you can cause it to billow dramatically, giving you advantage on one Charisma (Performance or Intimidation) check made within the next minute. Once used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Mood-Scent Brooch
Wondrous.description: This jeweled brooch gives off a harmless scent that reflects your mood, such as rain, roses, smoke, cut grass, or hot metal. As an action, you can choose the scent for 1 hour.

Wondrous.name: Goblin Sparkplug
Wondrous.description: This tiny sparking tool has 3 charges and regains all expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast mending, light, or prestidigitation.

Wondrous.name: Mage Apprentice's Chalk
Wondrous.description: This blue chalk has 5 uses. While holding it, you can expend 1 use to cast minor illusion or message. The chalk crumbles to dust when its final use is expended.

Wondrous.name: Tidesage Shell
Wondrous.description: While holding this shell, you can cast shape water. If you cast the cantrip while aboard a ship, underwater, or in heavy rain, you can also make your voice carry clearly through the shaped water until the start of your next turn.

Wondrous.name: Cenarion Seed
Wondrous.description: While holding this living seed, you can cast druidcraft. If you plant the seed in soil and leave it undisturbed for 1 hour, it grows into a Tiny harmless plant appropriate to the local environment.

Wondrous.name: Defias Marked Coin
Wondrous.description: This scratched coin is paired with another matching coin. While holding it, you can cast message, targeting only a creature holding the paired coin, provided both coins are within 1 mile of each other.

Wondrous.name: Priest's Candle Stub
Wondrous.description: While this small candle is lit, you can cast thaumaturgy or light. The candle burns for a total of 8 hours, in 1-minute increments, before becoming nonmagical.

Wondrous.name: Goblin Sapper's Kit
Wondrous.description: This compact demolition kit has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn if restocked with 10 gp of blasting supplies. As an action, expend 1 charge to plant a palm-sized bomb on a surface. At the end of your next turn, it detonates; creatures within 5 feet make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The blast also deals double damage to unattended objects.

Wondrous.name: Gnomish Calibration Tools
Wondrous.description: These delicate tools can tune firearms, constructs, clockwork devices, and other gadgets. Once per dawn, you can spend 10 minutes with the tools to give yourself advantage on one ability check made to repair, disable, or understand a mechanical device.

Wondrous.name: Enchanter's Silver Rod
Wondrous.description: As an action, you can touch this rod to a nonmagical weapon. For 1 minute, the weapon counts as magical and gains a +1 bonus to damage rolls. Once used, the rod can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Inscription Quill of Violet Ink
Wondrous.description: This quill never runs dry while copying maps, contracts, spell notes, or runes. Once per dawn, you can use it to cast comprehend languages, but only on written text.

Wondrous.name: Alchemist's Field Burner
Wondrous.description: During a short or long rest, you can use this folding burner and alchemist's supplies to brew one simple restorative draught. One creature that drinks it before the next dawn regains 1d6 hit points. The draught then spoils.

Wondrous.name: Cenarion Herbalist Pouch
Wondrous.description: Fresh herbs, seeds, and spellberries kept in this living pouch spoil after 30 days instead of 7. Once per dawn, you can use the pouch to identify whether a plant is poisonous, medicinal, edible, or magical.

Wondrous.name: Forsaken Distillation Rack
Wondrous.description: During a long rest, you can use this portable glass rack and alchemist's supplies to extract one dose of toxin from a poisonous creature, diseased sample, or contaminated liquid. The DM decides the poison's effect; if uncertain, use a DC 13 Constitution save or poisoned until the end of the target's next turn.

Wondrous.name: Shaman's Totem Carving Knife
Wondrous.description: During a short rest, you can carve wood, bone, or stone into a temporary minor totem. Choose fire, water, earth, or air. Before your next long rest, you can plant the totem as a bonus action to grant allies within 10 feet resistance to that element's common hazard for 1 minute, as judged by the DM. Once you create a totem this way, you can't do so again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Jewelcrafter's Lens
Wondrous.description: While using this folding lens, you have advantage on checks to appraise gems, spot counterfeit jewelry, or identify whether a gem is magical. Once per dawn, you can cast detect magic, but the spell detects only gems, jewelry, and inset stones.

Wondrous.name: Miner's Resonance Pick
Wondrous.description: This compact pick hums near ore, buried metal, or hollow stone within 30 feet. Once per dawn, you can strike a stone or metal surface with it to learn whether there is a hollow space, vein, door, or large metal object within 30 feet behind that surface.

Wondrous.name: Goblin Pop-Up Turret
Wondrous.description: As an action, you can deploy this folded tripod turret in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. For 1 minute, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to make the turret fire at a creature within 30 feet: ranged attack +5, 1d8 piercing damage. The turret falls apart after the minute ends.

Wondrous.name: Sapper Mine Plate
Wondrous.description: As an action, you can place this flat mine on the ground. The first creature that steps within 5 feet of it before the next dawn must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 fire damage and fall prone. The mine is destroyed when triggered.

Wondrous.name: Smoke Canister Tripwire
Wondrous.description: As an action, you can string this canister across a 5-foot opening. The first creature to cross it triggers a 10-foot-radius smoke cloud that heavily obscures the area until the end of the creature's next turn or until dispersed by strong wind.

Wondrous.name: Arcane Alarm Spike
Wondrous.description: As an action, you can press this violet spike into a floor, wall, or door frame. Until the next dawn, it silently alerts you if a Small or larger creature crosses within 10 feet of it while you are within 300 feet.

Wondrous.name: Kirin Tor Ward Pylon
Wondrous.description: As an action, plant this crystal pylon in an unoccupied space. For 1 minute, creatures of your choice within 10 feet of it gain a +1 bonus to saving throws against spells and magical effects. Once used, the pylon can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Argent Consecration Stake
Wondrous.description: As an action, drive this silver stake into the ground. For 1 minute, the ground within 10 feet is consecrated. Undead and fiends that start their turn there take 1d6 radiant damage, and allies in the area have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

Wondrous.name: Cenarion Root Snare
Wondrous.description: As an action, bury this knotted seed in soil, grass, or loose earth. The first Large or smaller creature that moves within 5 feet of it before the next dawn must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be restrained by roots until the end of its next turn.

Wondrous.name: Tauren Earthbind Totem
Wondrous.description: As a bonus action, plant this carved wooden totem in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. For 1 minute, hostile creatures that start their turn within 15 feet of it have their speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of their next turn. Once used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Tauren Ancestral Ward Totem
Wondrous.description: As a bonus action, plant this painted ancestor totem in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. For 1 minute, allies who start their turn within 10 feet of it gain 1d6 temporary hit points. A creature can gain these temporary hit points only once from this totem.

Wondrous.name: Shaman Grounding Totem
Wondrous.description: As a reaction when you or an ally within 10 feet is targeted by a spell, you can plant this totem. The target gains a +1d6 bonus to its saving throw against that spell, or a +2 bonus to AC if the spell uses an attack roll. The totem then cracks and becomes nonmagical.

Wondrous.name: Shaman Searing Totem
Wondrous.description: As a bonus action, plant this small fire totem. For 1 minute, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to make it spit flame at a creature within 30 feet: ranged spell attack +5, 1d6 fire damage. Once used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Shaman Cleansing Totem
Wondrous.description: As an action, plant this water-marked totem. Choose up to three creatures within 10 feet. Each target can immediately repeat one saving throw against being poisoned, diseased, frightened, or charmed. The totem is then spent until the next dawn.

Wondrous.name: Everwarm Bedroll
Wondrous.description: A creature that completes a long rest in this bedroll automatically succeeds on saving throws against extreme cold during the rest. If the rest happens in freezing weather, the creature also gains 1d6 temporary hit points when it wakes.

Wondrous.name: Cenarion Living Tent
Wondrous.description: This seed bundle grows into a two-person leafy shelter over 10 minutes, provided it is planted in soil. In forests, groves, or overgrown ruins, the tent blends into the surroundings and grants advantage on checks made to hide the camp.

Wondrous.name: Goblin Inflatable Raft
Wondrous.description: This folded rubber raft inflates as an action and can carry up to four Medium creatures across calm water. Whenever it takes damage, roll a d20; on a 1, it begins leaking and sinks after 1 minute unless repaired.

Wondrous.name: Tuskarr Ice Sled Harness
Wondrous.description: This whale-bone and hide harness lets one creature pull a loaded sled over snow or ice without being slowed by nonmagical difficult terrain. During overland travel in snow or sea ice, the party's pace is not reduced by the sled's load.

Wondrous.name: Dwarven Stonebite Pitons
Wondrous.description: These four climbing spikes bite into stone when twisted. While using them on stone or masonry, you have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to climb or secure a rope.

Wondrous.name: Stormproof Camp Lantern
Wondrous.description: This hooded lantern cannot be extinguished by nonmagical wind or rain. Once per dawn, you can shutter it as an action to make its light visible only to creatures within 10 feet for 1 hour.

Wondrous.name: Argent Wayfarer's Candle
Wondrous.description: This thick white candle burns for 8 hours. While lit at a campsite, undead of CR 2 or lower can't willingly enter bright light shed by it unless they succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. The candle's magic ends when its burn time is spent.

Wondrous.name: Traveler's Self-Inking Map
Wondrous.description: This blank map records the route traveled by its bearer over the last 24 hours, including major turns, rivers, roads, and campsites. It does not reveal hidden doors or unmapped areas the bearer did not perceive.

Wondrous.name: Campfire Ember Box
Wondrous.description: This iron box holds a coal that never fully dies. As an action, you can use it to ignite a campfire, torch, lantern, or other dry fuel. Once per dawn, it can also dry soaked firewood enough to burn.

Wondrous.name: Gryphon Rider's Weather Goggles
Wondrous.description: While wearing these goggles, rain, snow, sand, and strong wind do not impose disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight within 60 feet.

Wondrous.name: Kirin Tor Violet Seal
Wondrous.description: This violet wax-and-silver seal marks the bearer as authorized for minor Kirin Tor business. It can open simple arcane locks or warded reading rooms at the DM's discretion. Once per dawn, it can cast detect magic.

Wondrous.name: Goblin Liability Waiver
Wondrous.description: This aggressively stamped contract grants access to many goblin labs, auctions, or dangerous demonstrations where a normal visitor would be refused. Once, after a goblin-made item breaks or misfires, presenting the waiver can halve one repair, replacement, or hush-money cost.

Wondrous.name: Explorer's League Claim Tag
Wondrous.description: This brass tag can be tied to a relic at a dig site to mark a legal claim recognized by many Alliance scholars and expedition quartermasters. Once per dawn, you can use it while inspecting stonework, fossils, or ruins to learn their approximate age and cultural origin.

Wondrous.name: Ravenholdt Safehouse Key
Wondrous.description: This black iron key opens one Ravenholdt safehouse door in a major city, chosen by the DM. Using it may grant shelter, a disguise, or a dead drop, but it also marks the bearer as known to professional assassins.

Wondrous.name: Steamwheedle Debt Ledger Page
Wondrous.description: This torn ledger page proves that a merchant, sailor, guard, or minor official owes money to the Steamwheedle Cartel. It can be traded for a small favor, a discount, or leverage, provided the named debtor fears public embarrassment.

Wondrous.name: Darkmoon Prize Ticket
Wondrous.description: This purple ticket can be redeemed at the Darkmoon Faire for a random minor magic item, strange pet, rigged game entry, or inconvenient prize chosen by the DM. The ticket always smells faintly of popcorn and ozone.

Wondrous.name: Cenarion Grove Map
Wondrous.description: This living leaf-map shows hidden paths, moonwells, safe camps, and corrupted groves in one wilderness region chosen when found. In that region, the bearer has advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to find safe campsites.

Wondrous.name: Earthen Ring Storm Bowl
Wondrous.description: When filled with clean water, this stone bowl shows the next day's likely weather and any major elemental disturbance within 10 miles. Near coasts, mountains, or active elemental sites, it can also point toward the strongest disturbance.

Wondrous.name: Reliquary Relic Clamp
Wondrous.description: This gold-and-crimson clamp can be fixed around a small unstable relic as an action. The first trap, curse pulse, arcane shock, or structural collapse triggered by handling that relic is suppressed for 1 minute, giving time to move or study it.

Wondrous.name: Warden Moonlit Shackle
Wondrous.description: These silver-black manacles count as magical restraints. Fiends, shapeshifters, and creatures under illusion magic have disadvantage on checks made to escape them. In moonlight, the shackle also glows if the prisoner changes shape.

Wondrous.name: Tuskarr Whale-Bone Route Marker
Wondrous.description: Placed at camp, this carved marker helps travelers orient in snow, fog, or sea ice. Until moved, creatures who can see it have advantage on checks to return to the camp or avoid becoming lost within 5 miles of it.

Wondrous.name: Tortollan Story Shell
Wondrous.description: As an action, you can hold this shell near a willing speaker to record up to 1 minute of speech. The shell can later replay the recording exactly once, then becomes blank. It can hold only one recording at a time.

Wondrous.name: Nightborne Arcwine Passport
Wondrous.description: This lacquered passport grants plausible entry to elite social spaces, salons, arcwine tastings, and noble gatherings where Nightborne influence matters. It also marks the bearer as politically interesting to hosts and spies.

Trinkets.name: Acid
Trinkets.description: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a vial of Acid. Target one creature or object you can see within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency) or take 2d6 Acid damage.

Trinkets.name: Acid (vial)
Trinkets.description: As an action, you can splash the contents of this vial onto a creature within 5 feet of you or throw the vial up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. In either case, make a ranged attack against a creature or object, treating the acid as an improvised weapon. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 acid damage.

Trinkets.name: Adjustable Stilts
Trinkets.description: The stilts take 1 minute to put on or remove. They increase the height of any humanoid wearing them by 2 to 5 feet. Each stilt weighs 8 pounds and is 1 foot long when fully collapsed.

Trinkets.name: Adventurer's Ring
Trinkets.description: While the cover on this ring is open, the ring produces a flame that creates no heat and consumes no fuel. It sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. As a Bonus Action, you can close the cover, smothering the flame, or open it again.

Trinkets.name: Quel'dorei Trinket
Trinkets.description: Trinkets from Quel'Thalas 1 A bronzewood ring inscribed with the Elvish word for "hope" 2 A dried flower; if it's placed in water, it blooms 3 An ebony locket; when it's opened, an elven voice whispers "Always" 4 A tiny skull carved from dark wood 5 A finger bone inscribed with an unknown rune 6 An ivory flute which produces no sound 7 A small journal made from preserved leaves 8 A book of poetry written by undead elves

Trinkets.name: Alchemist's Doom
Trinkets.description: This sticky, adhesive fluid ignites when exposed to air. As an action, you can throw this flask up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. Make a ranged attack against a creature or object, treating the alchemist's doom as an improvised weapon. On a hit, the target takes 7 (2d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can end this damage by using its action to make a DC 10 Dexterity check to extinguish the flames.

Trinkets.name: Alchemist's Fire
Trinkets.description: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a flask of Alchemist's Fire. Target one creature or object you can see within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency) or take 1d4 Fire damage and start burning.

Trinkets.name: Alchemist's Fire (flask)
Trinkets.description: This sticky, adhesive fluid ignites when exposed to air. As an action, you can throw this flask up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. Make a ranged attack against a creature or object, treating the alchemist's fire as an improvised weapon. On a hit, the target takes 1d4 fire damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can end this damage by using its action to make a DC 10 Dexterity check to extinguish the flames.

Trinkets.name: Antitoxin
Trinkets.description: As a Bonus Action, you can drink a vial of Antitoxin to gain Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition for 1 hour.

Trinkets.name: Antitoxin (vial)
Trinkets.description: A creature that drinks this vial of liquid gains advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour. It confers no benefit to undead or constructs.

Trinkets.name: Eredar Music Box
Trinkets.description: This music box is made of dark wood with gold filigree. Each of its five sides is sculpted with the image of a horned woman playing a different musical instrument: a dulcimer, a flute, a harp, a lyre, and a viol. While touching the box, you can use an action to make it play music featuring one of the instruments shown, which can be heard up to 60 feet away. You can also use an action to stop the music.

Trinkets.name: Wyrmrest Trinket
Trinkets.description: Trinkets from Wyrmrest 1 A pierced dragon scale on a cord 2 A statuette of a dragon carved from black bone 3 A dragon's tooth, engraved with an unknown rune 4 A child's doll of a dragon, woven from leather cords 5 A dagger carved from a dragon's talon 6 A brass disk bearing the silhouette of a black dragon 7 A small egg-shaped piece of polished bone 8 A bone fragment with brass inlaid runes 9 A leather pouch filled with tiny draconic teeth 10 A single large seed that's warm to the touch

Trinkets.name: Assassin's Blood
Trinkets.description: A creature subjected to Assassin's Blood makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 6 (1d12) Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition for 24 hours. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

Trinkets.name: Backpack
Trinkets.description: A Backpack holds up to 30 pounds within 1 cubic foot. It can also serve as a saddlebag.

Trinkets.name: Backpack Parachute
Trinkets.description: A humanoid wearing this piece of gear can deploy the parachute as a reaction while falling, or as an action otherwise. The parachute requires at least a 10-foot cube of unoccupied space in which to deploy, and it doesn't open fast enough to slow a fall of less than 60 feet. If it has sufficient time and space to deploy properly, the parachute allows its wearer to land without taking falling damage. Once it has been used, the parachute takes 10 minutes to repack.

Trinkets.name: Ball Bearings
Trinkets.description: As a Utilize action, you can spill Ball Bearings from their pouch. They spread to cover a level, 10-foot-square area within 10 feet of yourself. A creature that enters this area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition. It takes 10 minutes to recover the Ball Bearings.

Trinkets.name: Barking Box
Trinkets.description: This metal cube, 6 inches on a side, has a crank on top. Using an action to wind the crank activates the box for 8 hours. While activated, the box barks whenever it detects vibrations within 15 feet of it, as long as the box and the source of the vibrations are in contact with the same ground or substance. A switch on one side of the box sets the device to emit either a small dog's bark or a large dog's bark.

Trinkets.name: Barrel
Trinkets.description: A Barrel holds up to 40 gallons of liquid or up to 4 cubic feet of dry goods.

Trinkets.name: Basic Poison
Trinkets.description: As a Bonus Action, you can use a vial of Basic Poison to coat one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition. A creature that takes Piercing or Slashing damage from the poisoned weapon or ammunition takes an extra 1d4 Poison damage. Once applied, the poison retains potency for 1 minute or until its damage is dealt, whichever comes first.

Trinkets.name: Basic Poison (vial)
Trinkets.description: You can use the poison in this vial to coat one slashing or piercing weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition. Applying the poison takes an action. A creature hit by the poisoned weapon or ammunition must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 1d4 poison damage. Once applied, the poison retains potency for 1 minute before drying.

Trinkets.name: Basket
Trinkets.description: A Basket holds up to 40 pounds within 2 cubic feet.

Trinkets.name: Bedroll
Trinkets.description: A Bedroll sleeps one Small or Medium creature. While in a Bedroll, you automatically succeed on saving throws against extreme cold (see the core rules).

Trinkets.name: Bell
Trinkets.description: When rung as a Utilize action, a Bell produces a sound that can be heard up to 60 feet away.

Trinkets.name: Biza's Breath
Trinkets.description: A creature subjected to this poison must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. The poisoned creature must use its action to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach. If there is no other creature within its reach, the poisoned creature does nothing on its turn. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Trinkets.name: Black Ghost Orchid Seed
Trinkets.description: Every few years, a ghost orchid colony grows a black pod as thick as a human fist that holds three soft, black seeds. A creature that consumes one of these black seeds is affected by the spell feign death. If the creature is unaware of the pod's effects or does not wish to be affected, it can resist the effect by succeeding on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. Otherwise, it is considered to be a willing recipient of the spell.

Trinkets.name: Black Sap
Trinkets.description: This tarry substance harvested from the dark boughs of the death's head willow is a powerful intoxicant. It can be smoked as a concentrate or injected directly into the bloodstream. A creature subjected to a dose of black sap cannot be charmed or frightened for 1d6 hours. For each dose of black sap consumed, a creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 2d4 hours-an effect that is cumulative with multiple doses.

Trinkets.name: Blanket
Trinkets.description: While wrapped in a blanket, you have Advantage on saving throws against extreme cold (see the core rules).

Trinkets.name: Blasting Powder
Trinkets.description: This volatile alchemical powder comes in a small pouch. When ignited by an open flame or a fuse, the powder explodes. Each creature within 5 feet of the exploding pouch must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A character can bind multiple pouches of blasting powder together so they explode at the same time. Each additional pouch increases the damage by 1d6 (maximum of 10d6) and the blast radius by 5 feet (maximum of 20 feet).

Trinkets.name: Blight Ichor
Trinkets.description: This bitter chartreuse concoction is distilled from a fungus native to the Blightshore badlands. The sickly green liqueur harbors potent psychedelic properties. Provided it is neither a construct nor undead, a creature subjected to a dose of blight ichor gains advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom checks, as well as vulnerability to psychic damage, for 1 hour. For each dose of blight ichor consumed, the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1d6 hours and suffer the effects of a confusion spell for 1 minute.

Trinkets.name: Block and Tackle
Trinkets.description: A Block and Tackle allows you to hoist up to four times the weight you can normally lift.

Trinkets.name: Blood of the Lycanthrope
Trinkets.description: This poison is created from blood harvested from a dead or incapacitated lycanthrope in its animal or hybrid form. A creature subjected to this poison must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with lycanthropy (see the bestiary). The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or similar magic. The type of lycanthropy depends on the lycanthrope used to create the poison. To determine the type of lycanthropy randomly, roll a d6: 1-3 Wererat 4-5 Werewolf 6 Wereboar

Trinkets.name: Book
Trinkets.description: A Book contains fiction or nonfiction. If you consult an accurate nonfiction Book about its topic, you gain a +5 bonus to Intelligence (Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion) checks you make about that topic.

Trinkets.name: Tome of Void Secrets (Variant)
Trinkets.description: A forbidden void-black tome filled with corrupting whispers. It is mostly a lore object unless the DM assigns powers from a darker grimoire.

Trinkets.name: Borderlands Tabard
Trinkets.description: While you're wearing this tabard, NPCs in the Keep on the Borderlands are initially Friendly [Attitude] toward you.

Trinkets.name: Bright Fungal Cloak
Trinkets.description: While wearing a Bright Fungal Cloak, you can take a Bonus Action to furl or unfurl it. When the cloak is unfurled, it sheds Bright Light in a 5-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 5 feet. One pound of fungus is sewn into a Bright Fungal Cloak. This fungus can be eaten as food. Once all the fungus is consumed, the cloak becomes a mundane set of Traveler's Clothes.

Trinkets.name: Bucket
Trinkets.description: A Bucket holds up to half a cubic foot of contents.

Trinkets.name: Bullseye Lantern
Trinkets.description: A Bullseye Lantern burns Oil as fuel to cast Bright Light in a 60-foot Cone and Dim Light for an additional 60 feet.

Trinkets.name: Burglar's Pack
Trinkets.description: A Burglar's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Ball Bearings, Bell, 10 Candle, Crowbar, Hooded Lantern, 7 flasks of Oil, 5 days of Rations, Rope, Tinderbox, and Waterskin.

Trinkets.name: Burnt Othur Fumes
Trinkets.description: A creature subjected to Burnt Othur Fumes must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) Poison damage, and it must repeat the save at the start of each of its turns. On each successive failed save, the creature takes 3 (1d6) Poison damage. After three successful saves, the poison ends.

Trinkets.name: Caltrop
Trinkets.description: As an action, you can spread a single bag of caltrops to cover a 5-foot-square area. Any creature that enters the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or stop moving and take 1 piercing damage. Until the creature regains at least 1 hit point, its walking speed is reduced by 10 feet. A creature moving through the area at half speed doesn't need to make the saving throw.

Trinkets.name: Caltrops
Trinkets.description: As a Utilize action, you can spread Caltrops from their bag to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. A creature that enters this area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 1 Piercing damage and have its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. It takes 10 minutes to recover the Caltrops.

Trinkets.name: Caltrops (bag of 20)
Trinkets.description: As an action, you can spread a single bag of caltrops to cover a 5-foot-square area. Any creature that enters the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or stop moving and take 1 piercing damage. Until the creature regains at least 1 hit point, its walking speed is reduced by 10 feet. A creature moving through the area at half speed doesn't need to make the saving throw.

Trinkets.name: Candle
Trinkets.description: For 1 hour, a lit Candle sheds Bright Light in a 5-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 5 feet.

Trinkets.name: Carrion Crawler Mucus
Trinkets.description: A creature subjected to Carrion Crawler Mucus must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. The creature also has the Paralyzed condition while Poisoned in this way. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Trinkets.name: Catapult Munition
Trinkets.description: A catapult munition roughly the size and weight of a cannonball. The munition can be thrown up to 30 feet and explodes on impact. Any creature within a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on the point of impact must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, each object in that area that isn't being worn or carried takes 35 (10d6) fire damage.

Trinkets.name: Chain
Trinkets.description: As a Utilize action, you can wrap a Chain around an unwilling creature within 5 feet of yourself that has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition if you succeed on a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check. If the creature's legs are bound, the creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping the Chain requires the creature to make a successful DC 18 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action. Bursting the Chain requires a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check as an action.

Trinkets.name: Chain (10 feet)
Trinkets.description: A chain has 10 hit points. It can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength check.

Trinkets.name: Chest
Trinkets.description: A Chest holds up to 12 cubic feet of contents.

Trinkets.name: Climber's Kit
Trinkets.description: A Climber's Kit includes boot tips, gloves, pitons, and a harness. As a Utilize action, you can use the Climber's Kit to anchor yourself; when you do, you can't fall more than 25 feet from the anchor point, and you can't move more than 25 feet from there without undoing the anchor as a Bonus Action.

Trinkets.name: Clockwork Dog
Trinkets.description: This Tiny clockwork dog made of copper and tin comes with a copper wind-up key. As an action, you can use the key to wind the dog, after which it follows you for 12 hours. At the end of that duration, the clockwork dog stops until wound again. The dog has AC 5, 1 hit point, and a walking speed of 30 feet.

Trinkets.name: Command Amulet
Trinkets.description: Each Shield Guardian is magically bound to an amulet. While the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (round up) is transferred to the guardian. A shield guardian's command amulet might be passed down through a magic-using society or family for generations.

Trinkets.name: Component Pouch
Trinkets.description: A Component Pouch is watertight and filled with compartments that hold all the free Material components of your spells.

Trinkets.name: Conch of Safe Rest
Trinkets.description: You can use an action to blow this pearlescent conch like a horn, creating an effect identical with that of a tiny hut spell. The conch disappears once the spell takes effect. The effect ends if you leave the spell's area.

Trinkets.name: Costume
Trinkets.description: While wearing a Costume, you have Advantage on any ability check you make to impersonate the person or type of person it represents.

Trinkets.name: Crampons
Trinkets.description: A crampon is a metal plate with spikes that is strapped to the sole of a boot. A creature wearing crampons can't fall prone while moving across slippery ice.

Trinkets.name: Crossbow Bolt Case
Trinkets.description: A Crossbow Bolt Case holds up to 20 Bolts.

Trinkets.name: Crowbar
Trinkets.description: Using a Crowbar gives you Advantage on Strength checks where the Crowbar's leverage can be applied.

Trinkets.name: Twilight's Hammer Trinket
Trinkets.description: Twilight's Hammer Trinkets 1 A dragon claw pendant on a leather cord 2 Ashes of a dracolich in a small brass canister 3 A map of an unknown dragon's lair 4 A black pearl etched with a Draconic rune 5 A drop of dragon's blood preserved in amber 6 A scrap of purple silk

Trinkets.name: Cultist's Robe
Trinkets.description: While wearing this occult outfit, you have Advantage on any ability check you make to impersonate a cultist in the Cult of Chaos.

Trinkets.name: Dancing Monkey Fruit
Trinkets.description: This rare magical fruit produces enough juice to fill a vial. Any humanoid that eats a dancing monkey fruit or drinks its juice must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or begin a comic dance that lasts for 1 minute. Humanoids that can't be poisoned are immune to this magical effect. The dancer must use all its movement to dance without leaving its space and has disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws, and other creatures have advantage on attack rolls against it. Each time it takes damage, the dancer can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. When the dancing effect ends, the humanoid suffers the poisoned condition for 1 hour.

Trinkets.name: Deathdance
Trinkets.description: A creature subjected to Deathdance must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. Humanoids automatically succeed on this save. The creature also has the Incapacitated condition while Poisoned in this way, as it thrashes uncontrollably.

Trinkets.name: Desert Clothing
Trinkets.description: When you are wearing Desert Clothing and not wearing Medium or Heavy armor, you automatically succeed on saving throws against the effects of extreme heat.

Trinkets.name: Dreadlord Mask
Trinkets.description: While you are wearing a Devil Mask, other creatures have Disadvantage on Intelligence (Investigation) and Wisdom (Insight) checks made to discern your true identity or intentions.

Trinkets.name: Dice Set
Trinkets.description: Wisdom Discern whether someone is cheating (DC 10), or win the game (DC 20)

Trinkets.name: Diplomat's Pack
Trinkets.description: A Diplomat's Pack contains the following items: Chest, Fine Clothes, Ink, 5 Ink Pen, Lamp, 2 Map or Scroll Case, 4 flasks of Oil, 5 sheets of Paper, 5 sheets of Parchment, Perfume, and Tinderbox.

Trinkets.name: Dowsing Dagger
Trinkets.description: A curved jade blade fashioned by the Jinyu Waterspeakers, this +1 dagger can detect the presence of fresh water within 200 feet of the wielder.

Trinkets.name: Dragon's Blood
Trinkets.description: Introduced into Sharn by Daask, dragon's blood is a potent and highly addictive stimulant. In addition to inducing euphoria, it can enhance spellcasting ability or even temporarily imbue a user with the ability to cast sorcerer spells. The drug's effects are potentially dangerous and always unpredictable. This isn't something a player character should want to use; adventurers are more likely to interfere with Daask smugglers or deal with an addict who accidentally casts a fireball in a crowded street. The specific effects of dragon's blood are up to you, but you can take inspiration from the Wild Magic Surge table in the core rules.

Trinkets.name: Dragonchess Set
Trinkets.description: Wisdom Discern whether someone is cheating (DC 10), or win the game (DC 20)

Trinkets.name: Dreamlily
Trinkets.description: A psychoactive liquid that smells and tastes like your favorite beverage, essence of dreamlily is a Sarlonan opiate. First imported to help manage pain during the Last War, it's now the most commonly abused substance in Sharn. Consuming dreamlily causes disorienting euphoria and brings about remarkable resistance to pain. A creature under the effects of dreamlily is poisoned for 1 hour. While poisoned in this way, the creature is immune to fear, and the first time it drops to 0 hit points without being killed outright, it drops to 1 hit point instead.

Trinkets.name: Shal'dorei Poison
Trinkets.description: This poison is typically made only by the shal'dorei, and only in a place far removed from sunlight. A creature subjected to this poison must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is also unconscious while poisoned in this way. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

Trinkets.name: Dungeoneer's Pack
Trinkets.description: A Dungeoneer's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Caltrops, Crowbar, 2 flasks of Oil, 10 days of Rations, Rope, Tinderbox, 10 Torch, and Waterskin.

Trinkets.name: Dust of the Mummy
Trinkets.description: This poison is created during a mummy's embalming process, distilled from the dead creature's removed organs. A creature subjected to this poison must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed creature can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the creature's hit point maximum to 0, the creature dies, and its body turns to dust. The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or similar magic.

Trinkets.name: Kaldorei Trinket
Trinkets.description: A small kaldorei keepsake. Roll or choose a fitting curio, token, or oddity for the character or scene.

Trinkets.name: Cenarion Circle Trinket
Trinkets.description: Cenarion Circle Trinkets 1 A pair of earrings made from oak leaves that never wilt 2 A miniature model cottage made of twigs 3 A green-glowing firefly in a bottle 4 A gourd that sounds like rustling leaves when held to one's ear 5 A preserved rabbit's foot on a leather strap 6 An antler shaped like an Elvish rune

Trinkets.name: Entertainer's Pack
Trinkets.description: An Entertainer's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Bedroll, Bell, Bullseye Lantern, 3 Costume, Mirror, 8 flasks of Oil, 9 days of Rations, Tinderbox, and Waterskin.

Trinkets.name: Essence of Ether
Trinkets.description: A creature subjected to Essence of Ether must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition for 8 hours. The creature also has the Unconscious condition while Poisoned in this way. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

Trinkets.name: Explorer's Pack
Trinkets.description: An Explorer's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Bedroll, 2 flasks of Oil, 10 days of Rations, Rope, Tinderbox, 10 Torch, and Waterskin.

Trinkets.name: Explosive Seed
Trinkets.description: This acorn-sized sphere of brass contains a small amount of blasting powder and a clockwork trigger. An explosive seed can be thrown up to 30 feet as an action, detonating on impact. Each creature within 5 feet of the exploding seed must make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d8 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Trinkets.name: Eyescratch
Trinkets.description: A creature that comes into contact with this poison must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 hour and blinded while poisoned in this way. A lesser restoration spell or similar magic ends the effect.

Trinkets.name: Faerie Dust
Trinkets.description: A pinch of this dust can substitute for the material components of any enchantment spell of 3rd level or lower. If a pinch of faerie dust is sprinkled on a creature, roll percentile dice and consult the Faerie Dust table to determine the effect. Faerie Dust 01-; The creature sprinkled with dust gains a flying speed of; feet for; minutes. 71-; The creature sprinkled with dust must succeed on a DC; Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 1 minute. The creature awakens if it takes damage or if it is shaken.

Trinkets.name: Falkir's Helm of Pigheadedness
Trinkets.description: This steel helm is shaped like the head of a boar. Once you don the helm, it can't be removed until you die or until a remove curse spell or similar magic is cast on it. If you wear the helm and are a humanoid, you gain the following flaw until the helm is removed: "I'm exceedingly stubborn and think I'm right all the time." (This flaw supersedes any conflicting flaw.)

Trinkets.name: Fargab
Trinkets.description: These backpack-sized devices are created in pairs, with matching numbers engraved on them, and allow communication over a long distance using radio frequencies. While wearing a fargab, you can use an action to speak into the device's mouthpiece and send a short message of twenty-five words or less to another creature wearing the matched fargab while it is within 18 miles of you. The message emits from the speakers of the device and can be heard up to 10 feet away from the device. If no creature is wearing the fargab, the speakers make static noises instead.

Trinkets.name: Emerald Dream Trinket
Trinkets.description: A small emerald dream keepsake. Roll or choose a fitting curio, token, or oddity for the character or scene.

Trinkets.name: Fine Clothes
Trinkets.description: Fine Clothes are made of expensive fabrics and adorned with expertly crafted details. Some events and locations admit only people wearing these clothes.

Trinkets.name: Fishing Tackle
Trinkets.description: This kit includes a wooden rod, silken line, corkwood bobbers, steel hooks, lead sinkers, velvet lures, and narrow netting.

Trinkets.name: Flask
Trinkets.description: A Flask holds up to 1 pint.

Trinkets.name: Winterspring Trinket
Trinkets.description: Trinkets from the Frostfell and Everice 1 A small prism carved from ice that doesn't melt 2 A rusted iron coin, depicting a dwarf lord and the worlds "Five Rex Undra" 3 A pair of eight-sided dice carved from ice that doesn't melt 4 A swatch of silvery fur that's cold to the touch, possibly from a winter wolf 5 A snowball; it doesn't melt and can't be compressed into ice 6 A tiny white dragon sculpted from ice that doesn't melt 7 A key carved from ice that doesn't melt 8 A single scale from a white dragon

Trinkets.name: Garb of Light and Shadow
Trinkets.description: This garb appeals to Fey from one Domain of Delight, such as the Gloaming Court or the Summer Court. While wearing the garb, you have Advantage on ability checks to influence Fey associated with that Domain of Delight.

Trinkets.name: Gate Warden Trinket
Trinkets.description: 1 A tiny vial pendant filled with a drop of honey that glows faintly 2 A small lead ingot that has a strange thumbprint pressed into it and whispers when held tightly 3 Two lodestone spheres that chime when they attract each other 4 A smoldering pebble of coal that, while always hot, doesn't burn skin, fur, scales, or clothing 5 A feather that sheds Vision and Light in a 5-foot radius 6 A ring made from a chain link that, once donned, won't come off without pulling painfully hard

Trinkets.name: Genie Robe
Trinkets.description: This robe appeals to Elementals associated with a particular Elemental Plane (Air, Earth, Fire, Water). While wearing a Genie Robe, you have Advantage on ability checks made to influence Elementals associated with that plane.

Trinkets.name: Giant Trinket
Trinkets.description: While exploring your home, you discovered some trivial remnant of the ancient inhabitants, as determined by rolling on the Giant Trinkets table. The items in parentheses are the normal-sized objects most analogous to the described giant trinkets.
